notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Biome Islands
notes.content:
New Features:
* Beach Added
* Ocean and Lakes Added
* Player now can swim in the water

Bug Fixes:
* Sometimes player cannot take red flowers
* Sometimes player cannot take blue flowers
* Stones appear now more frequently
* Enemies AI can now see players and hear them
* Player now can make a dig and place a block in the map faster
